articles.summary: Modine (NYSE: MOD), a diversified global leader in thermal management technology and solutions, today announced that it will become Modexus Solutions after completing the spinoff of its Performance Technologies business and merger with Gentherm. Under applicable law, the name change will be subject to approval by Modine's shareholders.
